item.title: Large peice of metal debris on the motorway, 9th August
item.description:
At approximately 4.45am on the 9th of august 2025, while travelling along A2 during hours of darkness, I drove over a large piece of metal debris that was lying in the carriageway. The debris was difficult to see due to the darkness and resulted in significant damage to my vehicle, completely puncturing and destroying one of my tyres. I subsequently became stranded and required breakdown assistance. I understand that at least three other vehicles also drove over the same piece of debris and suffered similar tyre damage, leaving multiple vehicles stranded at the roadside. This appears to have been a significant and hazardous obstruction in the carriageway, creating a serious risk to road users. I am seeking reimbursement for the costs incurred as a direct result of this incident, including the replacement tyre, breakdown/recovery costs and any other associated damage.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Rochester Way, Blendon, Greater London
